name: Bic Camera Inc.
summary: Bic Camera Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of audio and video products in Japan. It offers cameras, televisions, recorders/video cameras, audio equipment; household appliances, including refrigerators, washing machines, cooking appliances, seasonal appliances, and beauty and hairdressing appliances; personal computers, and computer peripherals, as well as information and communication equipment products, such as mobile phones, games, watches, used computers, sporting goods, toys, glasses, and contact lens.
